sn35.146:1.1: Navapurāṇāni bhikkhave kammāni desissāmi kammanirodham kammanirodhagāminiñca paṭipadaṃ ||
sn35.146:1.4: Cakkhum bhikkhave purāṇakammam abhisaṅkhatam abhisañcetayitaṃ vedaniyaṃ daṭṭhabbam || pa ||
sn35.146:1.5: Jivhā purāṇakammam abhisaṅkhatā abhisañcetayitā vedaniyā daṭṭhabbā || la ||
sn35.146:1.6: Mano purāṇakammaṃ abhisaṅkhato abhisañcetayito vedaniyo daṭṭhabbo || ||
sn35.146:1.9: Yaṃ kho bhikkhave etarahi kammaṃ karoti kāyena vācāya manasā
sn35.146:1.12: Yo kho bhikkhave kāyakammavacīkamma manokammassa nirodhā vimuttiṃ phusati ||
sn35.146:1.15: Ayam eva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo seyyathīdam
sn35.146:1.16: sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi || ||
sn35.146:1.18: Iti kho bhikkhave desitaṃ vo mayā purāṇakammaṃ || desitaṃ navakammaṃ || desito kammanirodho || desitā kammanirodhagāminī paṭipadā || || 8
sn35.146:1.19: Yaṃ kho bhikkhave satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hitesinā anukampakena anukampam upādāya kataṃ vo tam mayā || || 9
sn35.146:1.20: Etāni bhikkhave rukkhamūlāni etāni suññāgārāni jhāyatha bhikkhave mā pamādattha mā pacchāvippatisārino ahuvattha || || Ayaṃ vo amhākam anusāsanīti || || 2
